# DRP Fitness

> DRP Fitness is a gym in Cibitung, Kabupaten Bekasi, Indonesia. It offers gym access, personal training, senam, boxing, and muaythai.

- Website: https://drp-fitness.my.id/
- Address: Perumahan GramaPuri Tamansari No. 14 cc, RW.37, Wanasari, Cibitung, Kabupaten Bekasi, Jawa Barat 17520
- Phone/WhatsApp: +62 813-8433-4250
- Hours: Daily, 07:00–22:00 WIB
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/DRP+GYM/
